findings.derivation: The paper defines log_+ only for positive arguments, while h(y)=6+log_+(16/|y|) is used as a function on all real y. At y=0 it is undefined.
findings.repair: Set h(0)=+infinity. This is compatible with the extended-nonnegative rearrangement lemma and changes no integral or constant.
